list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(repository): implement domain ProductRepository and map entities
- Create ProductRepository interface in the domain layer with CRUD and custom operations. - Refactor ProductoRepository to implement the new ProductRepository interface. - Integrate ProductMapper to handle conversions between Producto (entity) and Product (domain). - Add @Repository annotation to ProductoRepository for Spring component scanning.

task.summary: chore: initial Spring Boot project stup

feat(persistence): add base entities
- Create core domain entities (Cliente, Categoria). - Add intermediate entity CompraProducto. - Implement composite key CompraProductoPK (@Embeddable and Serializable).

feat(persistence): implement product repositories and entity relationships
- Add @JoinColumn relationships to the corresponding entities. - Create ProductoCrudRepository interface extending Spring Data CrudRepository. - Implement ProductoRepository class with getAll() method to fetch products.
